4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Graded this week: your Block Breaker published with a working link turned in on Google Classroom, one new software pattern added (the Singleton pattern: one GameState object that holds score and lives), and a 3-sentence explanation of what it is, why we used it, and how it improves your game.
4th Period.workingNow: Open the Google Classroom assignment called Singleton Pattern. Read the instructions, follow them, and turn in your work when you are done. There is no exit ticket today.
4th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, my Block Breaker with GameState is published and I have written 3 sentences: what a Singleton is, why we used one, and how it helps my game.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.19 — Document programs in order to make them easier to use, read, test, and debug.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas and information, using appropriate technology.
agenda: Model: 3 sentences about a different example (5 min)
Commit, Sync Changes, hard refresh, check live game (10 min)
Turn in your link on Google Classroom (5 min)
4th Period.connections: Wednesday you made score and lives change through GameState. Today you publish your game and explain the Singleton pattern in your own words. Friday is the all-school presentation, so class meets next on Monday.
